title.zh: 【日本金融厅公布链上金融论坛会议纪要，多部门披露稳定币发放补贴、国债上链等进展】
title.en: 【日本金融厅公布链上金融论坛会议纪要，多部门披露稳定币发放补贴、国债上链等进展】

current_state.zh: Japan's Financial Services Agency published minutes from the first Onchain Finance Forum for the AI Era, detailing multi-agency plans to study tokenized government bonds, stablecoin-based subsidy disbursement, DLT settlement sandboxes, and a new Asia policy dialogue.
